{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    localparam BLOCKS = (WIDTH + 3) / 4;
    localparam PAD_WIDTH = 4 * BLOCKS;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(BLOCKS);

    wire sub_ab = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire sub_ba = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire subtracting = sub_ab | sub_ba;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] axb = a ^ b;
    wire [PAD_WIDTH-1:0] p, g;
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] block_p, block_g;
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] prefix_p [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] prefix_g [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] block_c;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_c;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_result;

    genvar i, j, level;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PAD_WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : bit_terms
            if (i < WIDTH) begin : active
                assign p[i] = axb[i] ^ subtracting;
                assign g[i] = (a[i] ^ sub_ab) & (b[i] ^ sub_ba);
            end else begin : padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b1;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end

        for (j = 0; j < BLOCKS; j = j + 1) begin : groups
            assign block_p[j] = &p[4*j +: 4];
            assign block_g[j] = g[4*j+3]
                | (p[4*j+3] & g[4*j+2])
                | (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & g[4*j+1])
                | (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & g[4*j]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign prefix_p[0] = block_p;
    assign prefix_g[0] = block_g;

    generate
        for (level = 0; level < LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin : prefix_levels
            for (j = 0; j < BLOCKS; j = j + 1) begin : prefix_nodes
                if (j >= (1 << level)) begin : combine
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][j] = prefix_g[level][j]
                        | (prefix_p[level][j] & prefix_g[level][j-(1 << level)]);
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][j] = prefix_p[level][j]
                        & prefix_p[level][j-(1 << level)];
                end else begin : pass_through
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][j] = prefix_g[level][j];
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][j] = prefix_p[level][j];
                end
            end
        end

        for (j = 0; j < BLOCKS; j = j + 1) begin : block_carries
            if (j == 0) begin : first
                assign block_c[j] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : remaining
                assign block_c[j] = prefix_g[LEVELS][j-1];
            end
        end

        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : local_carries
            if ((i % 4) == 0) begin : offset_zero
                assign bit_c[i] = block_c[i/4];
            end else if ((i % 4) == 1) begin : offset_one
                assign bit_c[i] = g[i-1] | (p[i-1] & block_c[i/4]);
            end else if ((i % 4) == 2) begin : offset_two
                assign bit_c[i] = g[i-1]
                    | (p[i-1] & g[i-2])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & block_c[i/4]);
            end else begin : offset_three
                assign bit_c[i] = g[i-1]
                    | (p[i-1] & g[i-2])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & g[i-3])
                    | (p[i-1] & p[i-2] & p[i-3] & block_c[i/4]);
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    assign arithmetic_result = axb ^ bit_c;

    always @* begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b001: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b010: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = axb;
            3'b110: sum = ~axb;
            default: sum = {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        endcase
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths cross a substantial arithmetic carry network before reaching the operation-selection logic. Separate addition and subtraction expressions also permit duplicated arithmetic hardware and reconvergent selection paths.",
  "rewrite": "Share one carry/borrow network across all three arithmetic operations. Addition uses XOR propagation and AND generation; subtraction uses XNOR propagation and direction-specific borrow generation. All three results are the original operand XOR combined with the computed carry or borrow. Four-bit lookahead groups feed a logarithmic parallel-prefix network, followed by explicit local lookahead. Logical operations and the zero default remain unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The bounded local lookahead and logarithmic intergroup network are intended to reduce maximum arrival below the 2.49 ns baseline. A roughly 10–20% reduction is a plausible target, not a measured result; the actual gain requires the specified mapping, STA, and electrical checks.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Sharing arithmetic should save hardware relative to three independent arithmetic expressions, while explicit prefix logic adds intermediate generate/propagate gates and routing. The design is intended to remain below the 6534.767360 um2 cap, but mapped area and electrical compliance have not been measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Purely combinational, with no added latency or state. Preserves the module name, ports, unsigned vectors, WIDTH parameter and default WIDTH=64, and modulo-2^WIDTH arithmetic. Supports WIDTH=32 and other positive widths, including partial final groups. Every binary opcode retains its reference behavior, including zero for 111. No assumptions, undefined outputs, library primitives, or external helper files are used."
}
